# Africola in the MICHELIN Guide

The MICHELIN Guide's listing for Africola on East Terrace in Adelaide, South Australia.

## Distinction

- Distinction: Bib Gourmand (good quality, good value cooking)
- Selection: MICHELIN Guide South Australia (inaugural 2027 selection)
- Cuisine: South African
- Chef: Duncan Welgemoed
- Address: 4 East Terrace, Adelaide SA 5000

## What the guide says

Chef Duncan Welgemoed crafts a rollicking good time in his Adelaide dining room, where peri peri chicken and flatbread with biltong butter are just the tip of the menu. His big personality translates into the food, which covers punchy South African barbecue and dishes with spice-heavy roots in North African cuisine. Diners frequently opt for the 'feed me' option.
